description: Bootstrap a new Vindicate Playwright project and/or wire CI. Linear arc with a CI-only entry. Satisfies the bootstrap completion gate (C15) before any test work begins. DELIVERY: served as ONE skill (nodes/setup.md), not per-node — the nodes here are the internal step sequence the single skill follows (see setup.graph.md delivery note).

edges.when: project root, app URL, stack, and target (ui/api/both) confirmed
folder structure + config files + BasePage and/or BaseApiClient + barrels written for the resolved target (scaffold_project)
dependencies installed (+ Playwright browsers, only when target includes ui)
CI file written for user-confirmed platform (e.g. .github/workflows/vindicate-tests.yml or bitbucket-pipelines.yml) (C14)
a reachability test runs green against BASE_URL
the app is unreachable or environment is broken
